title: Law to expand nonprofit swim programs at city pools
summary: This law would require the Parks Department to identify public pools where nonprofit organizations could offer swimming lessons and water safety programs, adding that information to the city's existing interactive pool map. If Parks finds a pool is not feasible for such programming, it must report to the Mayor and Council by May 1, 2027 explaining why and recommending ways to improve access. The law would take effect 90 days after becoming law.
